meta.notes: The records office: the pair room clear's own level. Four held rooms; every room is a choice of door and door tool. Kit pieces only. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts records

response.why: A records office in town at night, with a night desk in the front office and a telephone on it: gunfire the desk hears is a call, and a patrol car comes, off the street or round by the back lane. The desk taken first and quietly (the first room, from the dark lot) and nobody calls.

ways.name: the back lane
